# Missing value
age >

# Dangling AND
age > 30 AND

# A comma outside a list
age = 1, name = 'x'

# Unknown field
nope = 1

# Calculated fields cannot be filtered on
display = 'Ann Lee'

# > is not supported on a boolean field
active > TRUE

# CONTAINS is not supported on an enum field
plan CONTAINS 'pr'

# IN is rejected on arrays
tags IN ('go')

# Scalar text rejects a list after CONTAINS
name CONTAINS ('a', 'b')

# An undeclared enum value
plan = 'gold'

# A malformed uuid
uid = 'not-a-uuid'

# A timestamp needs an offset
created_at > '2026-10-27T10:00:00'

# An impossible date
due = '2026-02-30'

# An integer field rejects a decimal
age = 30.5

# A quoted number is not trimmed
age = ' 30'

# A boolean field needs TRUE or FALSE, not a string
active = 'true'

# NULL only goes with = and !=
age > NULL

# A time keyword on a text field
name = TODAY

# An unknown word on the value side
due = tomorrow

# The quoted BETWEEN form needs a comma
age BETWEEN '30'

# BETWEEN is not supported on text
name BETWEEN ('a', 'b')

# An empty item in an array's quoted list
tags CONTAINS 'go,,sql'

# CONTAINS takes no relative value, on any field
holidays CONTAINS TODAY

# Quoted identifiers keep their case
"Age" > 30
